visualReview.method: Re-review after the conceptLabel fix. Rendered-DOM probes (port 5867, loopback, servers stopped): strings scan of every preset plus default locale=es at 3 ratios (strings2.txt); sweep at u step 0.01 over every preset × labels all/key/none × ratio (sweep.json: floors, heads, fill, overlaps, text on cards, card collisions, out of frame, flashes, layoutOk); geom.mjs (link: no marker or arrowhead, endpoints at token edges, caption ownership, connectors under text checked via elementsFromPoint occlusion); seek identity (270 comparisons per ID); stress caps vs effective baseline (caps.mjs); qa.mjs warnings []; DOM-less core 4/4. Visual: composite strips (rows all/key/none, 10 times) viewed by me as listed in artifacts; 36 of 36 strips rendered, 12 viewed, plus one full-size detail sheet (zoom.png: 0463 1:1 hold, 0464 9:16 lens open and marker).
findings: Legal: 'consideration' appears only in 'Concept label (as supplied, illustrative): consideration' (stress: '... consideration (illustrative label)'; ES chip 'Etiqueta de concepto (según lo aportado, ilustrativa): consideration'). No sufficiency, adequacy, past or bargained-for, validity, enforceability, binding, formation or outcome wording in EN or ES. ES has no English beyond the chip. Links are a plain 'Linked as supplied' relation: 0 marker or arrowhead elements, endpoints at the token edges, and the caption sits nearest its own link. 'Question to be analysed' is shown dashed and neutral, not as a failure. ● and ◆ are drawn at equal size

Sweep: 0 below-floor, 0 text-over-text, 0 text-on-card, 0 card-card, 0 out-of-frame, 0 flashes, layoutOk everywhere; no text rendered at labels=none; geom: connectors that pass under text are hidden by opaque chips or cards, so 0 crossings are visible; seek: played/shuffled == fresh

Lens at 60 fps, every preset × labels × ratio: rest magnification card 1.636–2.03, text 1.65–2.0; sized hosts at 1280x720, 1400x1000, 1920x1080 and 800x600 all ≥ 1.55, default ≥ 1.6. A single copy of the datum (both 0, dimmed 0), 0 ms handoff gap, emptyMax 0, panel and lens never shown together, marker never shown with the lens. Visible context ≥ 0.46 (the larger of width and height share; 9:16 W 0.87). Lens overText 0, overHead 0, rim cuts 0, out of frame 0. Δ marker clear of text in every preset × labels × ratio. Guide lines never visibly cross text. 9:16 renders layoutOk in every preset (the DOM-less estimator's 'nofit' does not reproduce in the render). Heads min 54 px at 1:1 (≥ 50). Stress strictly longer, terms 2→3

contentReview.scope: Illustrative labelling, fictional data, no legal conclusion/verdict/ranking in the rendered scene. Not a legal verification.
